Az.bar_b_note: B's grounded, scaled coils come close to the owner bar, but A's glossy plastic banding and faint poses floating in mid-air sink the set as shipping-quality creature work.

Lo.bar_b_note: The sky is pleasant, but a single faceted boulder cone with one ribbon fall, no terraces, greenery or structures, and flat navy water reads as a prototype, not the board's inhabited Veilfall.

Ho.bar_b_note: A's overcast grey grade gives some storm mood, but there is no falling rain, and B's uniform fog turns the landmark into a flat pale cut-out rather than Valheim-style layered atmosphere.

Uz.bar_b_note: This matches Lo: clean light and sky, but a bare rock cone with one fall and sparse sandbar islets lacks the density and landmark language a Palworld-class vista needs.

Xr.bar_b_note: A's site-specific aftermaths (freed captive, smoke, fallen banner) are good storytelling, but smeared low-resolution ground, lollipop trees and flat midday light sit well below Palworld finish.

Qh.bar_b_note: A clean, appealing, expressive elder with a palette that fits the Meadows reads at shipping-character finish; only the slightly stiff full-body stance holds it back.

Ii.bar_b_note: As in Ho, overcast haze without rain streaks or splashes, plus B's fog washing out the whole mountain, gives a weather view no Valheim-class mood.

Qc.bar_b_note: B's braced timber frame with a cap and stone footing reads as Palworld-style base building, but the flat untextured infill, the flat-shaded pale boulder beside it and the blurry grass keep the finish short.

top_changes.change: Rebuild Veilfall as the board's stepped mountain: terraced cliff bands with tree-topped ledges, several tiered falls with mist, arches and bridges, and the stronghold gate behind the main fall.

Replace current chevrons and dashes with subtle foam and streak lines in every weather, and make the rain view read with visible rain streaks, sea-surface splashes and graded distance fog that keeps the landmark silhouette and its value range.

Sharpen the Meadows terrain and grade (Xr, Qc): replace the smeared low-res ground textures, add stronger directional sun with grounding contact shadows/AO, swap the flat-shaded pale boulders for the nature family's rocks, and give wall infill a plaster texture.
